purpose: CSP implementation evaluation using the same basic structure as the supplied six-scenario benchmark.

label_policy.PASS: Scenario is inside the source-reviewed general-maintenance temperature and pH ranges for every selected species, has no included high-risk blocked pair, and is not designed as a capacity violation.
label_policy.REJECTED: Scenario is designed to trigger one documented project rule: volume/capacity policy, temperature outside a source-reviewed general-maintenance range, adult angelfish-neon predation policy, or conservative Betta-guppy conflict policy.
label_policy.important_limitation: A maintenance range is not a lethal limit. A species-pair warning is not proof that every individual pairing is biologically impossible. Volume labels depend on the project's explicit capacity heuristic. Pair and capacity rules require independent domain-expert review before the benchmark can be described as expert-validated.
label_policy.tds_policy: TDS readings are retained for input-schema compatibility, but the selected species-profile sources do not establish species-specific TDS limits. These values must not be represented as independently validated TDS limits or used to claim biological validation.
label_policy.independence_policy: Scenarios are synthetic software test cases. Several intentionally vary a small number of base cases to test rules; they are not 100 independent empirical observations.
